bio_en: Haji Aram Gasapian was born in Bitlis on 12 May 1875. Encouraged as a schoolboy by Simon, one of Serob's favourite fighters, he formed a small group at eighteen and sought contact with the union in the Mush plain; Margar Varzhapet's hanging in 1893 deepened his resolve. When Serob entered the country with his band and was attacked at Sokhort in 1894, Haji Aram rushed from Bitlis to help, though the fight was over before he arrived. Later imprisoned for sixteen months by the Russian government and for a year and a half in Bitlis, he died suddenly of a burst heart vessel while riding near Aleppo on 1 October 1912, and was mourned in Bitlis.
